skills.name: 丰积
skills.text: 每轮开始时，你可以依次选择是否令对应项数值-1：1.摸牌阶段摸牌数；2.出牌阶段使用【杀】的次数上限。你每选择一项，便令一名其他角色本轮的对应项数值+2，选择完成后，你令本轮选择否的对应项数值+1。
notes: Trigger fengji-round-choice: new roundStarting window (shared capability), subject owner, optional, gated by new condition fengjiRoundChoicePending (facts-derived: the current actual turn is exactly the turn whose begin advanced the round ledger, extra turns excluded, and no ProgramFengjiOptionChosenEvent exists for this round and owner).

Bespoke op fengjiRoundChoice (7244) walks the two options in text order: each 是/否 prompt commits one scalar ProgramFengjiOptionChosenEvent; a 是 prompts a recipient among other living characters before committing (Accepted with RecipientSeat). Declined options commit immediately with +1 for the owner.

The round ledger feeds public rule queries: gated contributions in EvaluateDrawCount/EvaluateSlashUseLimit derive each seat's current-round adjustment from the committed facts (owner -1 / recipient +2 per accepted option; owner +1 per declined option), clamped by the existing [0,∞) bounds.

Round identity comes from RoundStartedEvent (UsesRoundTracking now also keyed on FengjiRoundChoice); effects are scoped to the committed RoundNumber, so a new round naturally drops the previous ledger.

skills.name: 旋回
skills.text: 准备阶段，你可以令所有受到“丰积”效果影响的其他角色与你交换对应的“丰积”效果，然后此技能失效直到一名角色死亡。
notes: Trigger xuanhui-swap: turnStartBeforeNormalFlow (established 准备阶段 window), subject owner, optional, gated by new condition fengjiSwapAvailable (skill not disabled by its own swap, and at least one accepted 丰积 option this round has a living recipient other than the owner).

Bespoke op xuanhuiSwapEffects (7245) commits one ProgramXuanhuiEffectsSwappedEvent for the round; the ledger derivation then flips the owner↔recipient assignment of every accepted option by swap parity for the remainder of the round (declined options' +1 has no counterpart and stays with the owner).

失效直到一名角色死亡 is ledger-derived: the skill counts as disabled exactly while the latest ProgramXuanhuiEffectsSwappedEvent is later than the latest PlayerDiedEvent in the committed history; any death re-enables the trigger. No serialized runtime state.

observations: Official hero/info API (gid=495) confirms 陈登 as qun 4HP with label 进攻/过牌/辅助 and quality 传说, matching the coordinator-locked record; the heroDetail JSON API remains unusable, but the official hero page https://www.sanguosha.com/hero/495 renders its skill section server-side and its SSR text was retrieved successfully for cross-checking.

Version-source discrepancy (recorded per the取证 requirement): the coordinator-designated text URL wiki.biligame.com/sgs/陈登 hosts the 十周年 classic version of 陈登 (望族/营说/扶援, 3HP, 荟萃-天下归心 pack, 2022-02-18, title 湖海之士) — a different general version that contradicts the locked OL 495 record (qun 4HP). None of its text was implemented. The OL-specific BWIKI (wiki.biligame.com/sgsol/陈登, last edited 2024-07-23) hosts the current OL normal version: 群、4 体力、称号 湖海豪气、璀璨星河-四弼 pack、上线 2022-06-03, and its current tab text (丰积 第2版 + 旋回) was implemented verbatim per the established 'BWIKI 当前普通版正文为准' rule.

BWIKI sgsol also records 丰积 第1版 (历史版本): 摸牌阶段开始时…下回合…本回合… — the implemented rule is the current per-round wording (每轮开始时/本轮); the older wording is recorded here only. The sgsol page's 其他 section notes the text was changed on 2024-07-23 without a same-day maintenance announcement.

Official page SSR wording differs from BWIKI sgsol in phrasing only: 丰积 official '你可以令你本轮以下至多两项数值-1…使用【杀】的限制次数…你未选择选项的数值+1' vs BWIKI '你可以依次选择是否令对应项数值-1…使用【杀】的次数上限…你令本轮选择否的对应项数值+1'; 旋回 official '令本轮其他丰积角色…交换对应丰积项效果，若如此做，本技能失效直到有角色死亡' vs BWIKI '令所有受到“丰积”效果影响的其他角色…交换对应的“丰积”效果，然后此技能失效直到一名角色死亡'. Both agree on the 每轮开始时 timing and the -1/+2/+1 shape; per the established rule the BWIKI current normal text wins and is what the presentation JSON carries.

New bespoke ops 7244-7245 (fengjiRoundChoice, xuanhuiSwapEffects); new trigger window roundStarting; new condition kinds 1027-1028 (fengjiRoundChoicePending, fengjiSwapAvailable) with gated nullable facts. No new PlayerMarkerKind, SkillProgramTriggerFactKind, trigger usage scopes or schema nodes; both evidence events are scalar-only records.
共享口径：丰积的轮级数值调整通过引擎侧规则查询贡献实现（依赖开关 TracksFengjiRoundLedger 按 HasTriggerOperation(fengjiRoundChoice) 门控，未启用该技能的指纹完全不受影响）；'失效直到一名角色死亡' 由事件账本推导（无新增序列化运行时状态），冷恢复按接受命令前缀确定性重建。
